## Purpose

Describe the student, instructor, or maintainer problem.

## Changes

List affected files and any effect on saved campaigns, PDF output, or hosting.

## Validation

Record actual build/manual checks and untested behavior. Use fictional examples and remove personal information or secrets.

## Deployment gate

- [ ] Existing competing Pages workflows and missing lockfile have been reviewed before any merge to main.
- [ ] The active host, publishing artifact, and rollback deployment are identified for a publishing change.
- [ ] Production merge/deployment has explicit maintainer approval.

Existing license terms and attribution must be preserved.
